decision: The maintainer explicitly chose not to reproduce erroneous upstream behavior, provided reproducible proof shows the upstream is wrong and the Rust behavior is correct; and chose a pure Rust FastQC implementation with explicit JVM launcher exceptions.
decision_quote: 1. 错误行为不复现，但需给出确凿的证据说明上游行为有误而我们的实现是正确的；2.A。
unachievable_decision_quote: 我建议在矩阵中加一列，命名为unachievable

exceptions.rule: Preserve each selected record's original format and quality provenance. Never fabricate quality for a FASTA record.

Use full IUPAC/RNA complement, exact three-base ORF coordinate spans, right-end-only trimming and lossless descriptions. Every raw difference must have independent proof and match the reviewed finite observation manifest.

exceptions.unachievable: Under the approved pure-Rust runtime, JVM executable selection and Java-launch diagnostics have no equivalent; Java/upstream delegation is excluded. See FASTQC-NATIVE-LAUNCHER proof.
exceptions.rule: Do not launch Java or delegate to upstream FastQC. Reject JVM executable selection and JVM-launch debug before input/output access with a clear usage diagnostic and exit 2.

Count full adapter matches independently of read order, including equal-length reads and later expansion of the reported position range. Reject configurations containing no usable adapter before processing input or creating reports, rather than crashing mid-report.

Do not invent zero quality for an unobserved tile/group. Report NaN and exclude absent observations from the reference mean, while retaining actual measured Q0. Preserve the pinned sampling, grouping and header-detection contract.
